Give me a quick overview of the NEXUS project.

NEXUS is a full-stack personal intelligence and decision platform. Instead of keeping projects, tasks, notes, analytics, learning goals, career records and git activity in separate tools, it connects them in one app so it can surface risks, recommendations and what to work on next. It was built over 14 development phases, and its AI layer today is a small intent classifier rather than a chat model.

What is the propose and confirm flow?

Today a sentence can go through POST /ml/action/propose, which classifies it and, using hand-written slot extraction, builds a proposal from a closed set of action kinds such as creating or updating tasks and projects. You review the proposal, and only POST /ml/action/confirm actually runs it through an owner-scoped service. Destructive kinds are flagged. No language model is involved and nothing runs without confirmation.
